tweaks.name: Minimize telemetry
tweaks.description: Sets the Windows diagnostic data policy to the minimum (Security/required level on supported editions).

tweaks.name: Disable activity history
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from recording and uploading your activity timeline.
tweaks.apply_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Name 'EnableActivityFeed' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Name 'PublishUserActivities' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Name 'UploadUserActivities' -Value 0 -Type DWord

tweaks.name: Stop app launch tracking
tweaks.description: Stops Windows tracking which apps you launch to personalize Start and search.

tweaks.name: Disable advertising ID
tweaks.description: Turns off the per-user advertising ID that apps use for targeted ads.

tweaks.name: Remove lock screen and Start suggestions
tweaks.description: Disables Spotlight overlay tips, suggested content and promoted app suggestions.
tweaks.apply_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-338387Enabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-338388Enabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord
tweaks.undo_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-338387Enabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-338388Enabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Copilot
tweaks.description: Turns off the Copilot sidebar via policy and hides the taskbar Copilot button.
tweaks.apply_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot' -Name 'TurnOffWindowsCopilot' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot' -Name 'TurnOffWindowsCopilot' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name 'ShowCopilotButton' -Value 0 -Type DWord

tweaks.name: Disable Recall snapshots
tweaks.description: Blocks Recall-style AI data analysis and screen snapshots (no effect on PCs without Recall).

tweaks.name: Disable Widgets
tweaks.description: Removes the Widgets board and its background web processes.
tweaks.apply_script:
try { Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name 'TaskbarDa' -Value 0 -Type DWord } catch { Write-OptiLog 'Taskbar Widgets toggle is protected on this Windows build; policy applied instead.' 'Warn' }
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Dsh' -Name 'AllowNewsAndInterests' -Value 0 -Type DWord
tweaks.undo_script:
try { Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name 'TaskbarDa' -Value 1 -Type DWord } catch { Write-OptiLog 'Taskbar Widgets toggle is protected on this Windows build.' 'Warn' }
Remove-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Dsh' -Name 'AllowNewsAndInterests'

tweaks.name: Local-only Start search
tweaks.description: Stops Start menu searches from sending keystrokes to Bing and showing web results.

tweaks.name: Merge svchost processes
tweaks.description: Sets the service-host split threshold to your RAM size so Windows runs fewer svchost.exe processes (fewer processes, slightly less overhead).

tweaks.name: Block background apps
tweaks.description: Prevents Store apps from running in the background for the current user, saving RAM and battery.

tweaks.name: Disable network in standby
tweaks.description: Turns off network connectivity during Modern Standby so the laptop drains less battery while the lid is closed.
tweaks.check_script:
$q = powercfg /q SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_NONE F15576E8-98B7-4186-B944-EAFA664402D9 | Out-String
$m = [regex]::Match($q, 'Current DC Power Setting Index:\s*(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)')
$m.Success -and ([Convert]::ToInt32($m.Groups[1].Value, 16) -eq 0)

tweaks.name: Disable update peer sharing
tweaks.description: Stops Windows uploading updates to other PCs over the internet or LAN (downloads only from Microsoft).

tweaks.name: Instant menus
tweaks.description: Removes the 400 ms delay before submenus open.

tweaks.name: Faster shutdown
tweaks.description: Shortens how long Windows waits for services and hung apps to close at shutdown.
tweaks.apply_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control' -Name 'WaitToKillServiceTimeout' -Value '2000' -Type String
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name 'WaitToKillAppTimeout' -Value '2000' -Type String
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name 'HungAppTimeout' -Value '1000' -Type String
tweaks.undo_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control' -Name 'WaitToKillServiceTimeout' -Value '5000' -Type String
Remove-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name 'WaitToKillAppTimeout'
Remove-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name 'HungAppTimeout'

tweaks.name: Taskbar End Task
tweaks.description: Adds an End task entry to the taskbar right-click menu for frozen apps (Windows 11 23H2+).

tweaks.name: Classic right-click menu
tweaks.description: Restores the full Windows 10 style context menu instead of the Show more options step.

tweaks.name: Disable transparency
tweaks.description: Turns off acrylic/mica transparency effects to save GPU and battery.

tweaks.name: Lighter visual effects
tweaks.description: Disables window animations and Aero Peek while keeping ClearType font smoothing and thumbnails.
tweaks.apply_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\VisualEffects' -Name 'VisualFXSetting' -Value 3 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name 'UserPreferencesMask' -Value ([byte[]](0x90,0x12,0x03,0x80,0x10,0x00,0x00,0x00)) -Type Binary
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop\WindowMetrics' -Name 'MinAnimate' -Value '0' -Type String
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name 'TaskbarAnimations' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\DWM' -Name 'EnableAeroPeek' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name 'FontSmoothing' -Value '2' -Type String
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name 'IconsOnly' -Value 0 -Type DWord
tweaks.undo_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\VisualEffects' -Name 'VisualFXSetting' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name 'UserPreferencesMask' -Value ([byte[]](0x9E,0x1E,0x07,0x80,0x12,0x00,0x00,0x00)) -Type Binary
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop\WindowMetrics' -Name 'MinAnimate' -Value '1' -Type String
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name 'TaskbarAnimations' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\DWM' -Name 'EnableAeroPeek' -Value 1 -Type DWord

tweaks.name: Disable mouse acceleration
tweaks.description: Turns off Enhance pointer precision for consistent 1:1 mouse movement (good for gaming).
tweaks.apply_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseSpeed' -Value '0' -Type String
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseThreshold1' -Value '0' -Type String
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseThreshold2' -Value '0' -Type String
tweaks.undo_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseSpeed' -Value '1' -Type String
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseThreshold1' -Value '6' -Type String
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseThreshold2' -Value '10' -Type String

tweaks.name: Keep kernel in RAM
tweaks.description: Stops Windows paging kernel and drivers to disk; snappier, but uses a little more RAM so it hurts very low-memory PCs.

tweaks.name: Disable Prefetch and Superfetch (SSD)
tweaks.description: Turns off prefetching, which only helps hard drives; on an HDD boot and app launch get noticeably slower.
tweaks.apply_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management\PrefetchParameters' -Name 'EnablePrefetcher' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management\PrefetchParameters' -Name 'EnableSuperfetch' -Value 0 -Type DWord
tweaks.undo_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management\PrefetchParameters' -Name 'EnablePrefetcher' -Value 3 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management\PrefetchParameters' -Name 'EnableSuperfetch' -Value 3 -Type DWord

tweaks.name: Disable memory compression
tweaks.description: Saves CPU spent compressing RAM, but on 4-8 GB machines it causes more paging and makes things slower. Presets only apply this through hardware tuning on 16 GB+ RAM.

tweaks.name: Enforce default file cache mode
tweaks.description: Makes sure LargeSystemCache is 0 (the desktop default) so RAM goes to apps rather than the file cache.

tweaks.name: Remove startup app delay
tweaks.description: Removes the artificial delay before desktop startup apps launch; apps start sooner but boot feels busier at first.

tweaks.name: Disable Fast Startup
tweaks.description: Makes shutdown a real shutdown, fixing stale-state glitches and driver issues; cold boots may take a few seconds longer.

tweaks.name: Disable hibernation
tweaks.description: Deletes hiberfil.sys and frees several GB of disk, but laptops lose hibernate (and Fast Startup).

tweaks.name: Disable power throttling
tweaks.description: Stops Windows limiting background app CPU speed; apps run faster but battery drains quicker.

tweaks.name: Disable USB selective suspend (plugged in)
tweaks.description: Keeps USB devices awake on AC power to avoid dropouts and wake lag; no effect on battery behaviour.
tweaks.check_script:
$q = powercfg /q SCHEME_CURRENT 2a737441-1930-4402-8d77-b2bebba308a3 48e6b7a6-50f5-4782-a5d4-53bb8f07e226 | Out-String
$m = [regex]::Match($q, 'Current AC Power Setting Index:\s*(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)')
$m.Success -and ([Convert]::ToInt32($m.Groups[1].Value, 16) -eq 0)

tweaks.name: Prioritise foreground apps
tweaks.description: Gives the app you are using short, variable CPU time slices with a boost (0x26); background tasks finish a bit slower.

tweaks.name: Reserve less CPU for multimedia
tweaks.description: Lowers the CPU share reserved for background multimedia from 20% to 10%, leaving more for foreground work.

tweaks.name: Disable network throttling
tweaks.description: Removes the multimedia network packet throttle for lower latency; can slightly raise CPU use during heavy transfers.

tweaks.name: Raise game scheduling priority
tweaks.description: Raises GPU, CPU and disk priority for games registered with the multimedia scheduler; background apps get slightly less.
tweaks.apply_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games' -Name 'GPU Priority' -Value 8 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games' -Name 'Priority' -Value 6 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games' -Name 'Scheduling Category' -Value 'High' -Type String
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games' -Name 'SFIO Priority' -Value 'High' -Type String
tweaks.undo_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games' -Name 'GPU Priority' -Value 8 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games' -Name 'Priority' -Value 2 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games' -Name 'Scheduling Category' -Value 'Medium' -Type String
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games' -Name 'SFIO Priority' -Value 'Normal' -Type String

tweaks.name: Enable Game Mode
tweaks.description: Turns on Windows Game Mode so games get priority and Windows Update avoids interrupting them.

tweaks.name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
tweaks.description: Lets the GPU manage its own memory scheduling for lower latency; needs a supported GPU and driver and can cause glitches on some.

tweaks.name: Disable fullscreen optimizations
tweaks.description: Forces true exclusive fullscreen for games, which can cut input lag but may break alt-tab and overlays in some titles.
tweaks.apply_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore' -Name 'GameDVR_FSEBehavior' -Value 2 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore' -Name 'GameDVR_HonorUserFSEBehaviorMode' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore' -Name 'GameDVR_DXGIHonorFSEWindowsCompatible' -Value 1 -Type DWord

tweaks.name: Disable Nagle algorithm
tweaks.description: Sends small packets immediately (TcpAckFrequency/TCPNoDelay) for lower online-game latency; slightly lowers throughput efficiency.
tweaks.apply_script:
$base = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces'
$keys = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $base -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $base + '\' + $_.PSChildName })
$act = @($keys | Where-Object { $ip = (@(Get-OptiRegistry -Path $_ -Name 'IPAddress') -join ''); $dh = (@(Get-OptiRegistry -Path $_ -Name 'DhcpIPAddress') -join ''); ($dh -ne '') -or (($ip -ne '') -and ($ip -ne '0.0.0.0')) })
foreach ($k in $act) {
  Set-OptiRegistry -Path $k -Name 'TcpAckFrequency' -Value 1 -Type DWord
  Set-OptiRegistry -Path $k -Name 'TCPNoDelay' -Value 1 -Type DWord
}

tweaks.name: Remove QoS bandwidth reserve
tweaks.description: Sets the QoS non-best-effort reservation to 0 so apps can use all bandwidth (the default reserve is already mostly unused).

tweaks.name: Disable LLMNR
tweaks.description: Turns off Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution, a chatty legacy protocol; rarely needed on home or school networks.

tweaks.name: Stop NTFS last-access updates
tweaks.description: Stops writing a timestamp every time a file is read, reducing disk writes; only tools that rely on last-access times notice.

tweaks.name: Disable 8.3 short names
tweaks.description: Stops creating legacy 8.3 filenames for new files, speeding up folders with many files; old 16-bit installers may misbehave, existing names stay.

tweaks.name: Raise NTFS memory cache
tweaks.description: Lets NTFS use more RAM for its metadata caches (NtfsMemoryUsage=2); faster file operations but takes RAM away from apps on small machines.

tweaks.name: Faster hover tooltips
tweaks.description: Cuts the mouse hover delay from 400 ms to 10 ms so hover previews and tooltips appear almost instantly; they may pop up by accident.

tweaks.name: Allow instant window focus
tweaks.description: Removes the lock that stops background apps stealing focus for 200 ms; windows you open come to front immediately but can grab focus too.

tweaks.name: Shorter input-hook timeout
tweaks.description: Caps how long a stuck keyboard/mouse hook can delay input to 1 second so a bad app cannot freeze typing; a slow legitimate hook may be skipped.

tweaks.name: Auto-close apps at shutdown
tweaks.description: Closes hung apps automatically at shutdown without asking, so shutdown never stalls, but unsaved work in them is lost.

tweaks.name: Silence startup sound
tweaks.description: Turns off the Windows boot chime; saves a fraction of a second and avoids noise in class or the library.

tweaks.name: Stop Sticky Keys prompt
tweaks.description: Disables the shortcut that pops up the Sticky Keys dialog when Shift is pressed five times, which often interrupts games; also disables that accessibility shortcut.

tweaks.name: Disable Customer Experience program
tweaks.description: Opts out of the Customer Experience Improvement Program usage reporting; no visible downside.

tweaks.name: Disable app compatibility telemetry
tweaks.description: Stops the inventory collector and program-compatibility reporting; Windows may offer fewer automatic compatibility fixes for old apps.
tweaks.apply_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AppCompat' -Name 'AITEnable' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AppCompat' -Name 'DisableInventory' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AppCompat' -Name 'DisableUAR' -Value 1 -Type DWord

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Error Reporting
tweaks.description: Stops crash reports being collected and sent to Microsoft; you lose automatic problem-solution suggestions.

tweaks.name: Stop feedback prompts
tweaks.description: Stops Windows asking for feedback and hides the feedback notifications.

tweaks.name: Disable tailored experiences
tweaks.description: Stops Microsoft using your diagnostic data to personalise tips, ads and recommendations.

tweaks.name: Block consumer features
tweaks.description: Stops Windows silently reinstalling promoted apps and showing cloud-driven suggestions; keeps removed bloat from coming back.
tweaks.apply_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent' -Name 'DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent' -Name 'DisableSoftLanding' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent' -Name 'DisableCloudOptimizedContent' -Value 1 -Type DWord

tweaks.name: Stop Start and tips suggestions
tweaks.description: Disables suggested apps in Start, silent app installs, OEM preinstalls and Windows tips; the Start menu looks plainer.
tweaks.apply_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-338389Enabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-353694Enabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-353696Enabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SilentInstalledAppsEnabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'PreInstalledAppsEnabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'OemPreInstalledAppsEnabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SoftLandingEnabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord
tweaks.undo_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-338389Enabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-353694Enabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-353696Enabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SilentInstalledAppsEnabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'PreInstalledAppsEnabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'OemPreInstalledAppsEnabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SoftLandingEnabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord

tweaks.name: Stop typing and inking collection
tweaks.description: Stops Windows collecting typing, inking and contacts to build a personal dictionary; autocorrect learns less from you.
tweaks.apply_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\InputPersonalization' -Name 'RestrictImplicitInkCollection' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\InputPersonalization' -Name 'RestrictImplicitTextCollection' -Value 1 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\InputPersonalization\TrainedDataStore' -Name 'HarvestContacts' -Value 0 -Type DWord
tweaks.undo_script:
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\InputPersonalization' -Name 'RestrictImplicitInkCollection' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\InputPersonalization' -Name 'RestrictImplicitTextCollection' -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-OptiRegistry -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\InputPersonalization\TrainedDataStore' -Name 'HarvestContacts' -Value 1 -Type DWord

tweaks.name: Stop handwriting data sharing
tweaks.description: Prevents handwriting samples being sent to Microsoft; irrelevant if you do not use a pen.

tweaks.name: Disable location services
tweaks.description: Turns location off system-wide by policy; Find My Device, maps and weather can no longer locate you.

tweaks.name: Disable Remote Assistance
tweaks.description: Blocks inbound Remote Assistance connections, closing an unneeded remote-access path; you cannot invite helpers this way.

tweaks.name: Stop Edge running in background
tweaks.description: Disables Edge startup boost and background mode, freeing a few hundred MB of RAM; Edge opens a little slower the first time.
